subtitle: Data Science & AI Research Dashboard
primaryResearchQuestion: What factors are most strongly associated with stress levels among university students?
datasetScope: Undergraduate and Postgraduate University Cohorts across Public, Private, and Research Institutions

pipelineStages.title: Data Understanding
pipelineStages.description: Exploration of 19 demographic, academic, lifestyle, and psychological variables.

pipelineStages.title: Data Cleaning
pipelineStages.description: Zero nulls confirmed; duplicate removal; categorical encoding.

pipelineStages.title: Feature Engineering
pipelineStages.description: Standardized Stress Score (0-100 & 1-5 scale) and composite Academic Pressure Index.

pipelineStages.title: Univariate Analysis
pipelineStages.description: Distribution, central tendency, dispersion, and skewness for each variable.

pipelineStages.title: Bivariate Analysis
pipelineStages.description: Correlation coefficients, scatter regression trends, and cross-tabulations.

pipelineStages.title: Multivariate Analysis
pipelineStages.description: 12x12 Correlation Matrix, 4D interaction bubble plots, and demographic faceting.

pipelineStages.title: Statistical Analysis
pipelineStages.description: Hypothesis testing: Pearson Correlation, Chi-Square of Independence, and One-Way ANOVA.

pipelineStages.title: Visualization
pipelineStages.description: High-fidelity Recharts and Three.js Serene Metric presentation.

pipelineStages.title: Insights
pipelineStages.description: Identification of primary risk drivers and protective lifestyle buffers.

pipelineStages.title: Recommendations
pipelineStages.description: Evidence-based institutional and personal wellbeing interventions.
